born February 28, 1999) is a Slovenian professional [[basketball]] player for [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] of the [[Liga ACB]] and [[EuroLeague]]. He represents the senior [[Slovenia national basketball team|Slovenian national team]], which he helped win its first [[EuroBasket]] title in [[EuroBasket 2017|2017]]. Listed as a 6-foot-8 (2.03 m), 228-pound (103 kg) [[guard (basketball)|guard]], Dončić is considered one of the best international prospects of his generation and is a projected top-three pick for the [[2018 NBA draft]].[http://www.eurohopes.com/player/1908/luka-doncic/ Luka Dončić] at Eurohopes A native of [[Ljubljana]], Dončić began his basketball career with the youth teams of Slovenian club [[KK Olimpija|Union Olimpija]], joining at eight years of age. In 2012, he joined [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] in Spain, eventually rising in profile on the [[Real Madrid Baloncesto B|reserve team]]. At age 16, in the [[2014–15 ACB season|2014–15 season]], Dončić debuted for Real Madrid in both the Liga ACB and EuroLeague, becoming the youngest player in club history to suit up in either competition. He found an increasing presence on the senior team in [[2016–17 ACB season|2016–17]], winning the [[EuroLeague Rising Star]] and [[ACB Best Young Player Award]]. In the [[2017–18 EuroLeague|2017–18 season]], Dončić assumed a leading role for Real Madrid, replacing its injured star player [[Sergio Llull]] for much of the season. Guiding his team to the [[2018 EuroLeague Final Four|2018 EuroLeague title]] at age 19, he became the youngest recipient of the [[EuroLeague MVP]] and [[EuroLeague Final Four MVP]] awards. He was also the youngest player to ever be named [[ACB Most Valuable Player Award|ACB Most Valuable Player]]. In addition, Dončić earned EuroLeague Rising Star and ACB Best Young Player accolades for his second straight season. Dončić is projected to be a top-three selection, and a contender for the [[List of first overall NBA draft picks|first overall pick]], in the [[2018 NBA draft]] on June 21, 2018.{{cite news|title=Consensus Mock Draft: Will Suns go with Deandre Ayton or Luka Doncic at No. 1?|url=http://www.nba.com/news/2018-consensus-mock-draft|accessdate=27 May 2018|work=NBA.com|date=23 May 2018|language=en}} ==Early life == Dončić was born in [[Ljubljana]], [[Slovenia]], to father [[Saša Dončić]], a basketball coach and former player with experience in the [[Premier A Slovenian Basketball League|Slovenian League]] and [[EuroLeague]]. His mother Mirjam Poterbin is a former [[hurdling|hurdler]], model, and dancer, and owner of a prestigious beauty salon in Ljubljana's inner circle.{{cite news | url= http://ekipa24.si/clanek/kosarka/reprezentancna-kosarka/567d5e0813259/spanski-potni-list | title = Španski potni list? |trans-title=Spanish passport? | author = Jurij Završnik | publisher = [[Ekipa (Slovenia)|Ekipa]] | date = 25 December 2015 | accessdate = 2 February 2017 | language = Slovenian }}{{cite news | url= http://lifestyle.enaa.com/ljudje/nusa-senk-zmesala-kosarkarja-sasa-doncica.html | title = Nuša Šenk zmešala košarkarja Saša Dončiča |trans-title=Nusa Senk captivated basketball player Sasa Doncic | author = | publisher = lifestyle.enaa.com | date = 18 September 2008 | accessdate = 2 February 2017 | language = Slovenian }}{{cite news | url= http://www.kosarka.si/luka-doncic-po-poti-gorana-dragica-in-rasa-nesterovica/ | title = Luka Dončić po poti Gorana Dragića in Raša Nesterovića |trans-title=Luka Doncic on track towards Goran Dragic and Rasho Nesterovic | author = Drako Perko | publisher = kosarka.si | date = 9 January 2015 | accessdate = 2 February 2017 | language = Slovenian }}{{cite news | url= http://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2017&mm=03&dd=10&nav_id=1238747 | title = Dončić: Luka Zvezdaš? Nasledio je to od mene |trans-title=Doncic: Luka a fan of Crvena Zvezda? He inherited that from me | author = NĐ | publisher = [[B92]] | date = 10 March 2017 | accessdate = 25 October 2017 | language = Serbian }}{{cite news | url= http://reporter.si/clanek/magazin/srbski-blic-izziva-slovence-brez-srbov-ne-bi-imeli-medalje-dragic-doncic-kokoskov-534644 | title = Srbski Blic izziva Slovence: Brez Srbov ne bi imeli medalje: Dragić, Dončić, Kokoškov... |trans-title=Serbian Blic is taunting Slovenes: Without Serbs you would not have a medal: Dragić, Dončić, Kokoškov... | author = | publisher = [[Reporter (magazine)|Reporter]] | date = 17 September 2017 | accessdate = 25 October 2017 | language = Slovenian }} His father is a Slovenian of [[Serbs|Serbian]] descent, with his family originating from the village of Biča, near [[Klina]].{{cite news | url= http://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2017&mm=03&dd=10&nav_id=1238747 | title = Dončić: Luka Zvezdaš? Nasledio je to od mene |trans-title=Doncic: Luka a fan of Crvena Zvezda? He inherited that from me | author = NĐ | publisher = [[B92]] | date = 10 March 2017 | accessdate = 25 October 2017 | language = Serbian }}{{cite news | url= http://reporter.si/clanek/magazin/srbski-blic-izziva-slovence-brez-srbov-ne-bi-imeli-medalje-dragic-doncic-kokoskov-534644 | title = Srbski Blic izziva Slovence: Brez Srbov ne bi imeli medalje: Dragić, Dončić, Kokoškov... |trans-title=Serbian Blic is taunting Slovenes: Without Serbs you would not have a medal: Dragić, Dončić, Kokoškov... | author = | publisher = [[Reporter (magazine)|Reporter]] | date = 17 September 2017 | accessdate = 25 October 2017 | language = Slovenian }} According to his family, Dončić first touched a basketball when he was seven months old, and by age one, he was frequently playing with a miniature hoop that his parents put in his room. He played a variety of sports in his childhood, including [[association football|soccer]], which he later quit after growing too tall.{{cite web |last1=Aravantinos |first1=Dionysis |title=Luka Doncic through his mother’s eyes! |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/trademarks/601550/story-week-luka-doncic-mothers-eyes/ |publisher=EuroHoops |accessdate=June 6, 2018 |date=January 25, 2018}} At age seven, he began playing organized basketball at primary school in Ljubljana.{{cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/20668236/there-never-nba-draft-prospect-slovenia-luka-doncic |title=There's never been an NBA draft prospect like Luka Doncic |first=Mike |last=Schmitz |publisher=''[[ESPN.com]]'' |date=September 18, 2017 |accessdate=September 18, 2017}}{{cite web|last1=West|first1=Andy|title=Conversation with Luka Doncic: 'I was born to play basketball'|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/899lwl554gpgofk6/conversation-with-luka-doncic-i-was-born-to-play-basketball|publisher=[[EuroLeague]]|accessdate=April 21, 2018|date=October 11, 2017}} His opponents at the time were up to ten years old, as Dončić reflected: "I was always training and playing with older kids who had much more experience than me. Many of them were bigger and faster than me too, so I had to beat them with my brain." He looked up to Greek professional basketball player [[Vassilis Spanoulis]] starting in his early teenage years.[http://www.eurohoops.net/en/euroleague/561446/doncic-got-enchanted-spanoulis/ Doncic: “I got enchanted by Spanoulis”.][https://twitter.com/MovistarMinuto0/status/934064417376997377 Los orígenes de @luka7doncic. #Minuto0 {{es icon}}.] == Youth career == When Dončić was an eight-year-old, his father started playing for Slovenian club [[KK Olimpija|Union Olimpija]], and Luka began training in the club's youth sections.{{cite web|last1=Davis|first1=Scott|title=Potential No. 1 NBA draft pick was so good at age 8 that coaches moved him up an age group after watching him play for 16 minutes|url=http://www.businessinsider.com/luka-doncic-too-good-slovenia-team-age-8-2017-9|publisher=[[Business Insider]]|accessdate=April 21, 2018|date=September 19, 2017}} He was initially expected to practice with players his age, but only 16 minutes into his first training session, he was moved to the 11-year-old group. Beginning in the following session, he primarily practiced with Olimpija's under-14 team, but due to league rules, he only played for the club's under-12 selection team under head coach Jernej Smolnikar, coming off the bench against opponents three or four years older than him. Due to his exclusion from under-14 games at the time, Dončić often requested his parents to practice, even when his coach asked him to stay home. [[File:Luka Doncic, Jorge Parra, Domagoj Proleta y Pablo Poyatos (13919153208) (cropped).jpg|thumb|Dončić is interviewed after a youth game with [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] in May 2014.]] Representing Olimpija at the under-14 Vasas Intesa Sanpaolo Cup in [[Budapest]] in September 2011, Dončić was named [[most valuable player]] (MVP) despite finishing as runners-up to [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]].{{cite web|title=Barcelona wins in Hungary; Doncic MVP|url=http://www.eurohopes.com/news/5575/barcelona_wins_in_hungary;_doncic_mvp|publisher=EuroHopes|accessdate=April 21, 2018|date=September 27, 2011}} In February 2012, he was [[loan (sports)|loaned]] to Spanish club [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] for the [[:es:Minicopa Endesa|Minicopa Endesa]], an under-14 Spanish club competition.{{cite web|last1=Duque|first1=Nacho|title=Luka Doncic, la perla que hace soñar al Madrid|url=http://www.marca.com/2013/02/08/baloncesto/acb/1360337892.html|website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|accessdate=April 21, 2018|language=Spanish|date=February 8, 2013}}{{cite web|last1=Alcaraz|first1=Ruben|title=Doncic, new millenium is close|url=http://www.eurohopes.com/news/5660/doncic,_new_millenium_is_close|publisher=EuroHopes|accessdate=April 21, 2018|date=February 23, 2012}} Dončić, who was among the youngest players on his team, averaged 13.0 points, 4.0 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 3.3 steals per game to win tournament MVP honors, leading Real Madrid to a second-place finish. In April 2012, he took part in the under-13 Lido di Roma Tournament for Olimpija, finishing as MVP and leading scorer with 34.5 points per game. In the semifinal round of the event against Victoria Fermo, he posted 29 points and 15 rebounds, and in a title-clinching win over Lazio, he erupted for 54 points.{{cite web|title=Doncic, now in Rome (54)|url=http://www.eurohopes.com/news/5691/doncic,_now_in_rome_54|publisher=EuroHopes|accessdate=April 21, 2018|date=April 11, 2012}} In September 2012, at 13 years of age, Dončić signed a five-year contract with the Spanish club [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]], immediately standing out on the under-16 team with coach Paco Redondo.{{cite web|url=http://www.marca.com/2013/02/11/baloncesto/nba/noticias/1360576177.html|title=Doncic, el prodigio de 13 años del Madrid|publisher=Marca.com|language=Spanish}} He moved to [[Madrid]], living with [[association football|soccer]] and basketball prospects, and he had to learn to speak [[Spanish language|Spanish]].{{cite web |last1=Laird |first1=Sam |title=Luka Doncic is the Best International Prospect Ever |url=https://www.slamonline.com/nba/luka-doncic-slam-cover/ |website=[[Slam (magazine)|Slam]] |accessdate=June 5, 2018 |date=May 15, 2018}} In February 2013, Dončić led Real Madrid to a Minicopa Endesa win, averaging 24.5 points, 13 rebounds, 4 assists, and 6 steals per game. In the final game of the tournament, he contributed 25 points, 16 rebounds, and 5 steals to defeat FC Barcelona and win MVP honors.{{cite web |last1=Duque |first1=Nacho |title=Doncic, el prodigio de 13 años del Madrid: "Cuando juego siento lo mismo que cuando sueño" |url=http://www.marca.com/2013/02/11/baloncesto/nba/noticias/1360576177.html |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |accessdate=June 9, 2018 |date=February 11, 2013}} In March, Dončić earned MVP accolades of the under-16 Spain Championship, scoring 25 points in a championship game win over the [[CB Gran Canaria|Gran Canaria]] youth team.{{cite web |last1=Novillo |first1=Esteban |title=La estrellas que vienen del baloncesto español se presentan al mundo |url=http://www.marca.com/blogs/cuna-de-talentos/2013/03/28/la-estrellas-que-vienen-del-baloncesto.html |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |accessdate=June 9, 2018 |language=Spanish |date=March 28, 2013}} In the 2014–15 season, Dončić mainly played with Real Madrid's under-18 team and [[Real Madrid Baloncesto B|reserve team]]. With the reserve team, he averaged 13.5 points, 5.9 rebounds, and 3.1 assists, helping them win Group B of the [[2014–15 Liga EBA season|Liga EBA]], the [[amateur sports|amateur]] fourth-division of [[Spanish basketball league system|Spanish basketball]].{{cite web |title=EBA 2014-15 Basketball |url=http://www.eurobasket.com/Spain/basketball-League-EBA_2014-2015.asp |publisher=[[Eurobasket.com]] |accessdate=June 3, 2018}}{{cite web |title=Real Madrid II |url=http://basketball.eurobasket.com/team/Spain/Real-Madrid-II/2338?Page=3&Stats=2015 |publisher=[[Eurobasket.com]] |accessdate=June 3, 2018}} By the end of the season, he earned all-league honorable mention honors from the basketball website [[Eurobasket.com]]. In January 2015, Dončić won the under-18 [[2014–15 Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament#Torneig de Bàsquet Junior Ciutat de L'Hospitalet|Ciutat de L'Hospitalet Tournament]] and was selected to the All-Tournament Team, despite being two years younger than the rest of the team.{{cite web|url=http://www.fiba.com/news/slovenian-luka-doncic-already-a-big-name-at-just-16|title=Slovenian Luka Doncic already a big name at just 16|date=23 April 2015|publisher=FIBA}} At the event, on January 6, against the youth team of his former club Union Olimpija, he posted a [[double (basketball)|double-double]] of 13 points, 13 rebounds, 4 assists, and 4 steals.{{cite web |title=Jan 6, 2015: Union Olimpija Junior Team vs. Real Madrid Junior Team |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2015-01-06/Union-Olimpija-Junior-Team-at-Real-Madrid-Junior-Team/205522 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=June 4, 2018}} In May 2015, he also won the under-18 [[2014–15 Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Next Generation Tournament]], for which he was selected MVP after helping defeat defending champions [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda Belgrade]] in the final.{{cite web|url=http://www.adidasngt.com/u18/news/latest/i/5yliexchngndhh9q/real-madrid-s-young-star-doncic-named-angt-mvp|title=Real Madrid's young star Doncic named ANGT MVP|publisher=AdidasNGT}} ==Professional career== ===Real Madrid (2015–present)=== ====Early years==== [[File:Lukadoncic.jpg|thumb|Dončić in a timeout in April 2015.]] On April 30, 2015, Dončić became the youngest player to debut with [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] in the [[Liga ACB]] ([[Spanish basketball league system|the top-tier Spanish League]]), at the age of 16 years, 2 months, and 2 days. He scored a three-pointer in Real Madrid's [[2014–15 ACB season|2014–15 season]] win against [[Baloncesto Málaga|Unicaja]]. In the history of the Liga ACB competition, he is the third-youngest player to make his debut, behind [[Ricky Rubio]] (who was 14 years and 11 months of age when he debuted), and Ángel Rebolo (who was 15 years and 3 months of age when he debuted).{{cite web|url=http://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2015/04/doncic-youngest-player-to-make-debut-for-real-madrid|title=Doncic, youngest player to make debut for Real Madrid|publisher=Real Madrid}} Dončić also participated in the [[2015 ACB Playoffs]], and the [[2015 FIBA Intercontinental Cup]]. In the 2015–16 season, Dončić became a part of the main 12-man roster of [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] in every competition, including the [[2015–16 ACB season]] (being the youngest player of the league),{{cite web|url=http://www.elmundo.es/deportes/2015/10/11/561950cae2704ec67a8b45b6.html|title=Doncic, youngest player in the league|publisher=El Mundo}} and the [[2015–16 Euroleague|EuroLeague 2015–16 season]]. He made his debut in the [[European professional club basketball system|European-wide top-tier level]], the [[EuroLeague]], on 16 October 2015, at the age of 16, in a road loss against [[BC Khimki|Khimki]]. Making him [[List of youngest EuroLeague players since the 2000–01 season|the eleventh-youngest player to make their debut in the EuroLeague since the 2000–01 season]]. Dončić scored 2 points in the game.[http://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamecode=1&seasoncode=E2015#!boxscore 2015-16 Regular Season Round 1 KHIMKI MOSCOW REGION 84 REAL MADRID 70 OCTOBER 16, 2015.] In week 8 of the Liga ACB, against [[Bilbao Basket]], he set his personal best in the Spanish League in: points scored (15), rebounds (6), assists (4), and [[Performance Index Rating|PIR]] (22), also setting the records in scoring and PIR for a player under age 17, in the history of the [[Liga ACB]].{{cite web|url=http://www.eurohoops.net/featured/153030/perfect-valencia-doncic-shined-video|title=Doncic shined|publisher=Eurohoops}} ====2016–17 season==== [[File:Luka Doncic 2016.jpg|thumb|right|Dončić warms up with Real Madrid in December 2016.]] During the 2016–17 season, Dončić got a place in the rotation of [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]], and was also an occasional starter. Dončić was named player of the week in the Liga ACB, for the first time, in the round 11 of the [[2016–17 ACB season|2016–17 season]], after scoring 23 points and grabbing 11 rebounds, for a [[Performance Index Rating|PIR]] of 34,{{cite web|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=127792|publisher=ACB.com|language=es|date=4 December 2016|accessdate=5 December 2016|title=Luka Doncic, Jugador de la Jornada 11}} in the win of Real Madrid against [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Montakit Fuenlabrada]], by a score of 92–76. In Round 13 of the [[2016–17 EuroLeague]], Dončić won his first [[EuroLeague MVP of the Round]] award, after scoring 16 points, to go along with 6 rebounds and 5 assists, for a PIR of 25, in a win over [[Brose Bamberg]].{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/7hnibo6ccfhnk7k9/round-13-co-mvps-luka-doncic-and-mike-james|title=Round 13 Co-MVPs: Luka Doncic and Mike James|publisher=EuroLeague|date=22 December 2016}} After winning three more EuroLeague MVP of the Round awards, Dončić won the [[EuroLeague Rising Star]] award, by a unanimous vote.{{Cite news|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/7ssonijxmjl9vexx|title=Rising Star Trophy: Madrid's Doncic is unanimous winner|date=10 May 2017|accessdate=10 May 2017|publisher=Euroleague.net}} On February 17, 2017, it was announced Dončić had signed with agent [[Bill Duffy (basketball)|Bill Duffy]] of BDA Sports.https://twitter.com/thesteinline/status/832654903994568706 ====2017–18 season==== During the month of October, Dončić was named the [[EuroLeague MVP of the Month]] for the performances he put up that month, most notably in Rounds 3 and 4, where he won back-to-back [[EuroLeague MVP of the Round]] honors, with leading [[Performance Index Rating|PIR]] scores in wins over [[Pallacanestro Olimpia Milano|AX Armani Exchange Olimpia Milan]] and [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]], respectively. On December 8, 2017, Dončić recorded a career-high 33 points, in Real Madrid's [[EuroLeague]] game against [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos Piraeus]], with Real Madrid losing 92–83 in overtime, that night. On 1 January 2018, the Spanish Liga ACB named Dončić their [[ACB Player of the Month|Player of the Month]], of December 2017, thus making Dončić the youngest player to win the award, at an age of 18 years and 10 months old.{{cite news|title=Luka Doncic, MVP Movistar de Diciembre|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=137417|accessdate=1 January 2018|work=www.acb.com|date=1 January 2018|language=Spanish}} On 30 March 2018, a day after Dončić hit a game-winning buzzer-beating three-pointer in an 82–79 win over [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda Belgrade]], his mother confirmed that he would declare for the [[2018 NBA draft]], but that he might not be at the event himself, due to the Spanish [[Liga ACB]]'s playoffs coinciding with the event.[https://clutchpoints.com/nba-draft-news-luka-doncic-mother-says-son-declare NBALuka Doncic’s mother says her son will declare for NBA Draft.] In any case, he was one of 11 truly international prospects to enter the [[NBA Draft]] that year, and he stated that he would wait until after the EuroLeague and Liga ACB competitions were completed before deciding on his future. On 8 May 2018, Dončić repeated as the winner of the [[EuroLeague Rising Star]] award, joining [[Nikola Mirotić]] and [[Bogdan Bogdanović (basketball)|Bogdan Bogdanović]] as the only repeat winners of the award.{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/8q3k4gyd7iac7dnc/2017-18-turkish-airlines-euroleague-rising-star-luka-doncic-real-madrid|title=2017-18 Turkish Airlines EuroLeague Rising Star: Luka Doncic, Real Madrid|work=Euroleague.net|accessdate=8 May 2018}} A day later, he recorded his first [[triple-double]] in the [[Liga ACB]], with 17 points, 10 rebounds and 10 assist against [[CB Sevilla|Real Betis Energía Plus]], in 22 minutes of playing time. With that achievement, he became the youngest player to record a triple-double in the competition.{{cite news|last1=Stroggylakis|first1=Antonis|title=Luka Doncic notches first career triple-double|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/acb/672135/luka-doncic-notches-first-career-triple-double/|work=Eurohoops|date=9 May 2018}} The next day, he was named a member of the [[All-EuroLeague Team|All-EuroLeague First Team]], being the youngest player in league history to earn such an honor. On May 18, Dončić recorded 16 points, 7 rebounds, and 2 assists, in a 92–83 over [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] in the EuroLeague Semifinals.https://www.sbnation.com/nba/2018/5/18/17369976/luka-doncic-stats-euroleague-final-four-pick-draft Real Madrid would go on to defeat the league's defending champions [[Fenerbahçe Men's Basketball|Fenerbahçe Doğuş]], in [[2018 EuroLeague Final Four|the finals game]], by a score of 85-80, thus winning the championship and 10th EuroLeague title in the club's history.{{cite news|title=Real Madrid is 2018 EuroLeague champion|url=http://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamecode=260&seasoncode=E2017#!report|accessdate=20 May 2018|work=euroleague.net|date=20 May 2018}} Dončić was named the [[EuroLeague Final Four MVP]], after recording 15 points, 3 rebounds, and 4 assists, to go alongside his stats recorded against CSKA Moscow.{{cite news|title=Doncic chosen Final Four MVP|url=http://www.euroleague.net/final-four/belgrade-2018/news/i/8r3oqram9e8uuqvt/doncic-chosen-final-four-mvp|accessdate=20 May 2018|work=euroleague.net|date=20 May 2018}} Over 33 EuroLeague games, Dončić averaged career-highs of 16 points, 4.8 rebounds and 4.3 assists per game. He was also named the 2018 [[EuroLeague MVP]] (and also recorded the highest [[Performance Index Rating|PIR]] of the entire season), thus being the youngest winner of the award in the process.{{cite news|title=2017-18 Turkish Airlines EuroLeague MVP: Luka Doncic, Real Madrid|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/8qwovagussoccaq6|work=[[EuroLeague]]|date=19 May 2018}} On 22 May 2018, he was named a member of the [[All-Liga ACB Team]]. A day later, Dončić was given the [[ACB Best Young Player Award]] once again, for being the best player in the league under the age of 22. He also earned his third straight appearance on the All-ACB Best Young Players Team. The next day, he was named the Liga ACB's [[ACB Most Valuable Player Award|MVP]] of the [[2017–18 ACB season|season]].{{cite news|title=Luka Doncic, MVP Movistar de la Liga Endesa 2017-18|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=140829|accessdate=26 May 2018|work=ACB.com|date=24 May 2018|language=Spanish}} Dončić would then help Real Madrid to win their third Spanish Liga ACB championship in four years (the club's 34th national league championship overall), as they won their series 3-1 against [[Saski Baskonia|Kirolbet Baskonia]]. ==National team career== ===Junior national team=== [[File:EuroBasket 2017 Finland vs Slovenia 66.jpg|thumb|Dončić, during [[EuroBasket 2017]].]] Dončić was set to play at the [[2014 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]]'s second level B tournament, with Slovenia's Under-16 junior national team, but he had to withdraw from the tournament, due to an injury. In December 2014, he played with the Slovenian Under-16 junior team, in a [[exhibition game|friendly game]] tournament in Hungary. Dončić averaged 35.3 points and 7.6 rebounds per game, while shooting 81% from two-point field goal range, and 57% on three-pointers. ===Senior national team=== On September 22, 2016, Dončić announced that he would represent the senior men's [[Slovenia national basketball team|Slovenian national team]] for the rest of his career.{{cite web|title=LUKA DONČIĆ: "Hvala Španiji, Slovenija je moja izbira!"|url=http://www.kosarka.si/luka-doncic-hvala-spaniji-slovenija-je-moja-izbira/|website=kosarka.si|accessdate=22 September 2016|language=sl-SL|date=22 September 2016}} He had previously been linked by the [[sports media]] with a number of other national teams, including [[Montenegro national basketball team|Montenegro]], [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia]], and [[Spain men's national basketball team|Spain]].{{cite news | url= http://www.rtvslo.si/sport/kosarka/doncic-na-evropskem-prvenstvu-gremo-po-medaljo/413818 | title = Dončić: Na evropskem prvenstvu gremo po medaljo |trans-title=Doncic: At the Eurobasket we are aiming for a medal | author = T. J. | publisher = [[RTV Slovenija]] | date = 30 January 2017 | accessdate = 2 February 2017 | language = Slovenian }} At the end of July 2017, Dončić debuted with the senior [[Slovenia national basketball team|Slovenian national basketball team]], in a game against Russia's Under-22 junior national team. In that game, he had 14 points, 6 rebounds, and 4 assists, in 14 minutes of playing time. Dončić was a member of the Slovenian squad for [[EuroBasket 2017]], where his country won its first gold medal, after going undefeated (9–0) in the tournament.{{Cite news|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/eurobasket/2017/news/slovenia-overcome-injuries-to-claim-historic-title|title=Slovenia overcome injuries to claim historic title in Dragic's swansong|date=2017-09-17|publisher=FIBA.basketball|accessdate=2017-09-19}} In Slovenia's quarterfinal 103–97 win over [[Latvia national basketball team|Latvia]], he scored 27 points, while also recording 9 rebounds.{{Cite news|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/eurobasket/2017/1209/Slovenia-Latvia|title=Slovenia v Latvia|date=2017-09-12|publisher=FIBA.basketball}} He recorded 11 points, 12 rebounds and 8 assists, in the 92–72 semi-final win over [[Spain men's national basketball team|Spain]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/eurobasket/2017/1409/Spain-Slovenia#tab=boxscore_statistics|title=Spain v Slovenia|publisher=FIBA.basketball|date=2017-09-14}} In the final, which Slovenia won by a score of 93–85 over [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia]], he had 8 points and 7 rebounds, before falling out of the game, due to an injury, in the game's third quarter.{{Cite news |url= http://www.fiba.basketball/eurobasket/2017/1709/Slovenia-Serbia#%7Ctab=boxscore_statistics |title= Slovenia v Serbia |date= 2017-09-19 |publisher= FIBA.basketball}} Dončić was also named to the competition's [[FIBA EuroBasket All-Tournament Team|All-Tournament Team]], joining teammate [[Goran Dragić]], who wqas also voted the [[EuroBasket MVP]].{{Cite news |url= http://www.fiba.basketball/eurobasket/2017/news/title-hero-dragic-caps-off-fairy-tale-finish-with-mvp-honors |title= Title hero Dragic caps off fairy tale finish with MVP honors |date= 2017-09-17 |publisher= FIBA.basketball}} == Player profile == Dončić has been described as a "position-less guard" who can play the [[point guard]], [[shooting guard]], and [[small forward]] positions.{{cite web |last1=Ramirez |first1=Jordan |title=Get to Know: Luka Doncic |url=https://www.nba.com/kings/blog/get-know-luka-doncic |publisher=[[National Basketball Association|NBA]] |accessdate=June 10, 2018 |date=May 26, 2018}} Standing {{convert|6|ft|8|in|m|2}} and weighing {{convert|228|lbs|kg|1}}, he has been praised for his exceptional size and strength for the [[guard (basketball)|guard]] position, which helps him on the defensive end.{{cite web |last1=Green |first1=Austin |title=What you need to know about Luka Doncic, the most polished European teen prospect ever |url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/2018-nba-draft-what-you-need-to-know-about-luka-doncic-the-most-polished-european-teen-prospect-ever/ |publisher=[[CBSSports.com|CBS Sports]] |accessdate=June 10, 2018 |date=June 5, 2018}} His basketball IQ, intangibles, and skills have been considered his primary assets, and he is seen as an elite facilitator, especially on the [[pick and roll]].{{cite web |last1=Wasserman |first1=Jonathan |title=NBA Exec Says Luka Doncic 'Leap Years Above Anyone' After EuroBasket Brilliance |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2732792-nba-exec-says-luka-doncic-leap-years-above-anyone-after-eurobasket-brilliance#slide2 |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |accessdate=June 10, 2018 |date=September 14, 2017}} As an [[NBA draft]] prospect, his lack of lateral quickness to stay in front most NBA point guards and wings has been labeled as a point of concern.{{cite web |title=Will Luka Doncic Take The NBA By Storm? |url=http://www.nba.com/hawks/draft-profile-luka-doncic |publisher=[[National Basketball Association|NBA]] |accessdate=June 10, 2018 |date=June 6, 2018}} In June 2018, [[CBSSports.com|CBS Sports]] projected him to "immediately be one of the best passers in the NBA." As a scorer, Dončić is capable of making [[Three-point field goal|three-pointers]] and mid-range [[Jump shot (basketball)|jump shots]], and converting on floaters and shots in the post. Basketball journalist and scout Austin Green compared him to [[Paul Pierce]] and [[Joe Johnson (basketball)|Joe Johnson]]http://www.nba.com/hawks/draft-profile-luka-doncic, while commentator [[Fran Fraschilla]] said that Dončić possesses the skill level and body type of [[Gordon Hayward]] and the mind of [[Manu Ginóbili]].{{cite web |last1=Bondy |first1=Stefan |title=Why one college basketball analyst warns not to overhype Luka Doncic |url=http://www.nydailynews.com/sports/basketball/college-hoops-analyst-not-overhype-luka-doncic-article-1.3954919 |website=[[New York Daily News]] |accessdate=June 10, 2018 |date=April 27, 2018}} Dončić has compared himself to [[Ben Simmons]] due to his versatility.{{cite web |last1=Kimes |first1=Mina |title=Luka Doncic Is No Darko Milicic |url=http://www.espn.com/espn/feature/story/_/id/23051130/will-luka-doncic-next-star-nba-player-europe |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=June 10, 2018 |date=April 9, 2018}} ==Career statistics==
